title: The Last Train Out
summary: You fled the falling moon on the Vagrant's last train.

epilogue.title: The Last Train Out
epilogue.text: The Vagrant opens her up full throttle, and behind you the moon comes down on Wickermoor Hollow like a dropped plate.

epilogue.title: Wickermoor Village
epilogue.text: You never learn what became of the village, and you never stop wondering.
